metadata.name: Highway Slow Vehicle Ahead
metadata.description: Euro NCAP CCRm 2026 style on the straight Town04 highway lane used by S41/S42: slow_car (spawn #92, ~100 m ahead in the same lane) drives at a constant 20 km/h while the ego starts at and holds ego_speed_kmh. Expected: the ego slows down behind slow_car or changes lanes, without a collision. 100 m gives at least 6 s to collision at 80 km/h, above the 4 s Euro NCAP starts from (NHTSA #24 Lead Vehicle Moving at Lower Constant Speed). Spawn points checked against Town04 map_metadata (75 → 92 same lane and yaw); verify on CARLA.

ego_speed_kmh.description: Ego test speed: the ego starts at this speed and is held to it while slow_car drives at 20 km/h (Euro NCAP CCRm 2026: 30–80 km/h in 10 km/h steps).
